title: Protocol Encoder
text: Encode input data into a uint8 byte stream by specifying the packet structure, 1 input, 1 output, {Terminator} sets Terminator of the; {Header}, {Field name} sets the name of the field in the packet structure, {Input field length} sets the length of the input field as per the data, {Input field data type} sets the data type, {Byte order} sets the endianess of the field in the packet Little, {Specify logic to generate checksum for validation} enables the logic for checksum validation and select the logic XOR, {Checksum size} sets the size of checksum bytes specified in the function used for custom algorithm numeric, {File path} sets the path of the function and {Custom terminator}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Field1
ports.summary: First field to be encoded by the block scalar

params.name: Header
params.values: Header of the packet character array | array of numeric values less than 255

params.name: Field name
params.values: Name of the field in the packet structure Field1 (default) | string

params.name: Input field length
params.values: Length of the input field as per the data type 1 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: Input field data type
params.values: Data type of the field uint8 (default) | int8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | single | double

params.name: Byte order
params.values: Endianess of the field in the packet Little endian (default) | Big endian

params.name: Specify logic to generate checksum for validation
params.values: Enable the logic for checksum validation and select the logic XOR of bytes | 2’s complement of sum of bytes | Custom algorithm

params.name: Checksum size
params.values: Size of checksum bytes specified in the function used for custom algorithm numeric scalar

params.name: File path
params.values: Path of the function (.m) used for custom checksum logic MATLAB ® path

params.name: Terminator
params.values: Terminator of the packet (default) | CR (’\r’) | LF (’\n’) | CR/LF (’\r\n’) | NULL (’\0’) | Custom Terminator

params.name: Custom terminator
params.values: Custom terminator of the packet character array | array of numeric values less than 255
